events.description: South Korean firm Hanwha Aerospace announced that its U.S. subsidiary will carry out ship‑based tests of the Chunmoo missile system off the West Coast.

events.title: Philippines seeks bespoke BrahMos missiles from India for island defence
events.description: Manila announced plans to acquire Indian‑made BrahMos cruise missiles, signalling a shift toward diversified defence procurement.

events.title: Pope Leo arrives in Argentina amid divisions over Milei’s austerity
events.description: Pope Leo XIV landed in Buenos Aires, calling for social justice and dialogue as the country grapples with President Milei’s economic reforms.

events.title: New Zealand's new lawmakers start to arrive at parliament as government remains in limbo
events.description: Freshly elected MPs began convening in Wellington’s parliament building while coalition talks continue to determine the next government.

events.title: Attack on Iraq gas complex disrupts supply to region’s power plants, authorities say
events.description: A drone strike hit the Emirati‑owned Khor Mor gas field in Iraq’s Kurdistan region, halting gas deliveries to local power stations.

events.title: Iran Urges Washington To Accept 2-Day Proposal To End Hostilities Or Face 'Hell'
events.description: Iranian foreign minister Abbas Araghchi demanded the United States accept a two‑day plan to reopen the Strait of Hormuz in exchange for lifting sanctions, warning of severe consequences.

events.title: Iran’s proposals on opening Strait of Hormuz still on table — top diplomat
events.description: Iranian foreign minister Abbas Araghchi said Tehran remains ready to negotiate the reopening of the Strait of Hormuz if Washington meets its demands.

events.title: CENTCOM launches task force to disrupt Iranian ground routes
events.description: U.S. Central Command created a new task force to interdict Iranian overland networks used to move advanced weapons and materials.

events.title: Collision of two trains in Egypt kills at least seven
events.description: Two passenger trains collided near al‑Ayyat, south of Cairo, killing seven people and injuring about 125.

events.title: COP31 conference in Turkey aims to move climate up the agenda in a crisis‑rocked world
events.description: World leaders gathered in Antalya for the 31st UN climate conference, seeking stronger commitments amid energy and geopolitical tensions.

events.title: Tens of thousands march in Amsterdam, pressing Dutch government on Gaza, Israel
events.description: Demonstrators gathered in Amsterdam demanding stricter sanctions on Israel and a declaration of genocide over the Gaza conflict.

events.title: G7 ministers to discuss recent cyber attacks, Italy says
events.description: Foreign ministers at the G7 meeting in Paris will address a series of cyber incidents attributed to pro‑Russian groups.

events.title: Russia Continues Strikes On Ukrainian Military Infrastructure and Transports
events.description: Russian forces bombed the Kamenskaya substation, a key power source for Ukraine’s defence industry, further degrading its war capability.

events.title: US strikes ship after Hormuz blockade breach
events.description: The U.S. military hit a vessel attempting to leave an Iranian port, citing a breach of the naval blockade in the Strait of Hormuz.

events.title: Ukraine's Zaporizhzhia nuclear plant again relies on backup power
events.description: The Zaporizhzhia nuclear power station continues to operate on emergency generators after repeated attacks on its grid connections.

events.title: Israel Defence Minister says 'mission not complete' on Iran
events.description: Israel's defence minister warned that Iran's nuclear ambitions remain a danger and that Israel's mission to counter it is ongoing.

events.title: US to target Iran’s land‑based supply routes – CENTCOM
events.description: The United States announced a new task force aimed at disrupting Iran’s overland logistics and supply chains.

events.title: Gunman kills 6 in Krakow main square, three more bodies found at his house
events.description: Un atacante disparó desde un coche en la Plaza del Mercado de Cracovia, matando a seis personas y hiriendo a decenas; posteriormente se hallaron tres cadáveres en su domicilio.

events.title: US military says it disabled cargo vessel in Gulf of Oman
events.description: Una aeronave estadounidense disparó contra un buque comercial que intentaba romper el bloqueo estadounidense a Irán, dejándolo inmovilizado.

events.title: Paraguay’s prosecutors charge former President Santiago Peña over Ueno Bank collapse
events.description: El ex presidente Santiago Peña es acusado y se solicita su detención preventiva por su presunta responsabilidad en la quiebra del Banco Ueno.

events.title: Israeli President Herzog Tasks Eisenkot with Forming Government in Setback for Netanyahu
events.description: El presidente Isaac Herzog asignó a Gadi Eisenkot la tarea de formar el próximo gobierno israelí, marcando un giro político importante.

events.title: Netanyahu faces being ousted as rival given chance to form new Israeli government
events.description: Israel’s president authorises opposition leader Gadi Eisenkot to attempt to build a coalition, indicating potential shift in Israeli leadership.

events.title: Israeli president taps Netanyahu rival to form government as coalition battle looms
events.description: President appointed Gadi Eisenkot with Knesset backing, but deep divisions over Arab parties and conscription threaten coalition formation.

events.title: Israeli president picks Gadi Eisenkot to form government: Statement
events.description: President Isaac Herzog tasked former military chief Gadi Eisenkot with forming a new coalition government after Netanyahu's era ended.

events.title: Mass shooting in Polish market leaves at least 6 dead, 15 injured
events.description: A gunman drove onto Krakow's main square and opened fire, killing six people and wounding fifteen.

events.title: Masked protesters set off firecrackers and block roads in Albania
events.description: Police used water cannons to disperse masked protesters who blocked streets in Tirana, Albania's capital.

events.title: U.S. Is Seeking To Expand Its Blockade On Iran Despite Growing Bipartisan Opposition To The Conflict
events.description: CENTCOM created a 20‑member task force to disrupt Iran's land and Caspian Sea supply routes, intensifying Washington's economic pressure campaign.

events.title: Heavy rains flood 70,000 displacement tents across Gaza
events.description: Heavy rain flooded tens of thousands of tents housing displaced Palestinians in the Gaza Strip, leaving many families without shelter.

events.title: US military targets Iranian defense system in latest round of limited strikes
events.description: The United States launched limited strikes against Iran's air defence systems, marking a new escalation in the region.

events.title: Pope 'in fairly good shape' – Leo begins South America tour in Uruguay
events.description: El Papa Francisco inicia su gira por Sudamérica en Montevideo, Uruguay, con miles de fieles reunidos en la costa.

events.title: Iran executes Baluch militant over armed attack on police station
events.description: Iran carries out the death sentence on a Baluch man convicted of an armed assault on a police station in the country's southeast, which left several officers killed or wounded.

events.title: Northern Road Bridge, TPP, power substation, missile plant hit in Kiev
events.description: Russian forces use precision‑guided weapons and drones to strike a bridge, a thermal power plant, a substation and a missile factory in Kiev and the surrounding region.

events.title: U.S. offers $20 million for information on Iran's nuclear program
events.description: The Rewards for Justice program announces a $20 million bounty for tips on Iran's nuclear facilities, equipment and personnel.

events.title: Pakistani astronaut to board Shenzhou 24 and become the first foreigner on China's space station
events.description: A Pakistani astronaut will fly aboard China's Shenzhou 24, marking the first foreign national to visit the Tiangong space station.

events.title: Princess Anne to arrive in the Falklands on the eve of the Hamburg hearing
events.description: Princess Anne, sister of King Charles III, will visit the Falkland Islands, signaling diplomatic engagement with the territory.

events.title: Haitian gang reaches out to state disarmament group as gunfights persist
events.description: One of Haiti’s most powerful gangs contacted a government agency to discuss peace, stability and national reconciliation.

events.title: Vance leads behind-the-scenes push for new Iran deal
events.description: Vice President JD Vance is personally involved in indirect talks with Iran to revive a ceasefire and restart nuclear negotiations.

events.title: Zelenskyy expects more support in Washington as Democrats take House, Senate
events.description: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy said he anticipates increased U.S. assistance following the Democratic takeover of Congress.

events.title: Taiwan shuts Papua New Guinea office and ends LNG buying, citing Chinese pressure
events.description: Taiwan closed its diplomatic office in Port Moresby and halted LNG purchases amid alleged Chinese influence over PNG.

events.title: Morocco marks anniversary of Western Sahara occupation as UN mission ends
events.description: The UN peacekeeping mission in Western Sahara concludes after 35 years, opening a new diplomatic phase in the long‑running territorial dispute.

events.title: Yemen's Houthis say 30 dead in Saudi strikes on market in Taiz
events.description: Houthis report that Saudi air strikes on a market in Taiz province killed around 30 people, intensifying the conflict in southern Yemen.

events.title: Somalia: Court Says President Term Extension Unlawful
events.description: Somalia's Supreme Court ruled that the president's one‑year term extension was illegal, sparking political tension and clashes.

events.title: Putin discusses upcoming trilateral talks on Ukraine with Russian Security Council
events.description: President Vladimir Putin outlines plans for a trilateral meeting on the Ukrainian settlement to be held in the United Arab Emirates.

events.title: Houthi attack kills 30 at market in Taiz
events.description: Houthi forces bombed a market in Taiz, Yemen, killing at least 30 people and injuring eight.

events.title: China moves former provincial leaders to the National People’s Congress
events.description: Beijing appointed 12 former provincial party chiefs and governors to senior positions in the legislature as part of a senior‑cadre reshuffle.

events.title: Ethiopia rebases its economy to $201 bn, raising tax revenue expectations
events.description: Addis Ababa announced a statistical rebasing that lifts Ethiopia’s GDP to $201 bn, prompting higher tax collection forecasts.

events.title: Ethiopia: A $201bn economy on paper, a heavier tax bill in practice
events.description: Addis Ababa rebases its GDP to $201 billion, confirming its rank as Africa’s third‑largest economy but raising concerns over higher tax burdens.
